annotations.title: Check an MCP server before connecting

description: Call before connecting to a remote MCP server, and whenever a call to it fails. Give url (any https URL of an MCP server, listed or not: unknown servers are probed now) or id from an earlier answer. Returns: alive, advice (ok / ok_requires_auth: working; unverified_yet: not fully checked yet; caution_tools_changed or caution_suspicious_tool_description: confirm with the user first; avoid_down or avoid_not_working_as_listed: do not connect), trust_score (0-100, open formula at https://alalanet.com/trust) with flags, checked_at and last_alive_at, uptime 24h/7d/30d, the tool-set diff (tools_diff, tools_changed_at), tool descriptions that look like hidden instructions (tool_description_flags), the digest of the server's initialize instructions, and when the advice is caution_* or avoid_*, up to 3 working MCP servers on other hosts. Default answers from recent checks (100 a day free); live=true probes now and adds a signed, logged attestation (5 live checks a day free). Read-only for the caller; an unknown URL joins the public catalogue.

id.description: service id from an earlier answer; give either id or url

live.description: true probes the server now and returns a signed, logged receipt; false (default) answers from recent checks

url.description: https URL of the remote MCP server to check; unknown servers are probed now and added to the public catalogue (private, loopback, link-local and cloud-metadata addresses are refused)

name: check_service
